title: TabuLM: Morphology-Aware Tabular Pre-training for Low-Resource Languages
abstract: arXiv:2608.26923v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present TabuLM, the first language model pre-trained on Kinyarwanda tabular data. Kinyarwanda is a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda, yet lacks any dedicated tabular representation learning resource. TabuLM extends KinyaBERT-large, a two-tier morphological transformer, with additive row, column, and cell-type embeddings and a learned table-structure attention bias that sharpens same-row and same-column attention. Pre-training uses two new objectives: Masked Cell Recovery (MCR), which masks entire cells and forces reconstruction from row and column context, and Column Type Prediction (CTP), which predicts column semantic types from observed cell values. translated_title: TabuLM：面向低资源语言的形态学感知表格预训练
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TabuLM，这是首个在基尼亚卢旺达语表格数据上预训练的语言模型。基尼亚卢旺达语是一种形态丰富的班图语言，由卢旺达超过1200万人使用，但此前缺乏专门的表格表示学习资源。TabuLM扩展了KinyaBERT-large（一种双层形态变换器），通过添加行、列和单元格类型的加性嵌入，以及一种学习到的表结构注意力偏置，该偏置增强了同行和同列的注意力。预训练采用了两个新目标：掩码单元格恢复（MCR），该目标掩蔽整个单元格并强制从行和列上下文中重建；以及列类型预测（CTP），该目标根据观察到的单元格值预测列的语义类型。我们在来自NISR、RAB、REB和MoH开放数据门户的172个卢旺达政府表格（约35,000个单元格）上进行了预训练，并引入了TabQA-kin，这是首个原生基尼亚卢旺达语表格问答基准，包含31个表格中的526个问答对。
tldr: 本文提出了TabuLM，首个面向基尼亚卢旺达语的形态学感知表格预训练模型，通过新目标MCR和CTP及结构注意力偏置，在低资源语言上实现了有效的表格表示学习，并构建了首个原生问答基准TabQA-kin。
en_tdlr: This paper presents TabuLM, the first morphology-aware tabular pre-training model for Kinyarwanda, leveraging novel MCR and CTP objectives with structural attention bias, achieving effective table representation learning in a low-resource language and introducing the first native QA benchmark TabQA-kin.
